INT. DOWNTOWN APARTMENT BATHROOM — MORNING. morning. Natural lighting appropriate to morning. #FFFFFF, #F0E6D3, #D4536D, #1A1A1A, #E8F4E8. Products shown in real-life context -- hands opening packaging, fingers pressing textures, products on bathroom shelves, kitchen counters, rumpled linen. No BGM, no music. Generate only dialogue, environmental sounds, and action sounds.

The video is styled as modern social-first product photography with a tactile, editorial energy. The lighting is bright natural morning light with airy, lifted shadows and a slight warmth in the highlights. The color palette relies on crisp whites, neutrals, and a singular pop of coral from the product.

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, the video begins with <Image 1>. <Subject 2> stands in front of a sleek bathroom mirror. She reaches up with her hand to hold <Subject 3>. She twists the base of the lipstick, extending the coral bullet with a tactile mechanical click. She then carefully applies the coral lipstick to her lower lip. The reflection in the mirror is clear and legible, showing the precision of the application. The camera performs a smooth, energetic handheld drift, creating a sense of intimate, realistic morning preparation.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a snappy quick push-in on <Subject 2>. She looks into the mirror reflection and breaks into a fresh, confident grin, showcasing the vibrant color of the lipstick contrasting sharply against her black turtleneck. <Subject 2> looks directly toward her reflection and speaks clearly: <d>[English] One shade. Whole city.</d>
